question.prompt: Define \(x~\diamondsuit~ y\) to be \(|x-y|\) for all real numbers \(x\) and \(y.\) What is the value of \[(1~\diamondsuit~(2~\diamondsuit~3))-((1~\diamondsuit~2)~\diamondsuit~3)?\]

solutions.title: Work from the inside out
solutions.explanation:
Both innermost operations involve numbers differing by \(1\), so evaluating them first simplifies both parts of the expression:
\[
2\mathbin\diamondsuit3=|2-3|=1,
\qquad
1\mathbin\diamondsuit2=|1-2|=1.
\]
The first parenthesized term is therefore
\[
1\mathbin\diamondsuit1=|1-1|=0,
\]
and the second is
\[
1\mathbin\diamondsuit3=|1-3|=2.
\]
Finally, the ordinary subtraction between these terms gives
\[
0-2=\boxed{-2},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
